description:
Extracted source occurrence. Status is stored as-is; never coerce INFERRED/PREDICTED to CONFIRMED.

Keep this contract compact. amount/currency/transaction_time come from structured
transaction records; call_time/duration come from structured CDR records.

id.description: ML relationship ID for this extracted occurrence
id.title: Id

source_entity_id.description: ML mention ID of the source occurrence, not a canonical UUID
source_entity_id.title: Source Entity Id

target_entity_id.description: ML mention ID of the target occurrence, not a canonical UUID
target_entity_id.title: Target Entity Id

source_document_id.description: FIR/document provenance. Backend maps document_id → case_id.
source_document_id.title: Source Document Id

source_record_id.description: CDR/transaction provenance, e.g. cdr_000123 or txn_000987
source_record_id.title: Source Record Id

title: Relationship
